notes: Section names are provisional until lyrics timing is available.
BPM is almost stable around 131; intensity is mapped mainly from note density, chord motion, chorus candidates, and manual interpretation.
Songle melody notes expose start, duration, and index only; do not treat them as pitch data.

globalRhythm.feel: steady fast 4-beat drive with dense vocal-entry hints and hard-cut downbeat potential
globalRhythm.downbeatUse: procedure ticks, screen cuts, panel snaps, and lamp shutter changes

sections.label: cold open / intro incision
sections.role: first incision, title ignition, listener pulled into the room
sections.rhythm: 8 beats, stable 131 BPM, one long melody note hint
sections.visualState: near-black, tilted table line, offset lamp wake
sections.transitionOut: hard clinical cut into measurement grid

sections.label: intro / A-melo entry
sections.role: rapid setup, diagnosis starts before the viewer is settled
sections.rhythm: steady fast beat; melody density is already very high
sections.visualState: diagnosis panels, pulse trace, small verdict tags around the table
sections.transitionOut: panels stack upward; public pressure becomes more record-like

sections.label: A/B-melo build
sections.role: tightening argument and first lift into chorus
sections.rhythm: 50 beats; very high density, many non-chord or unstable zones
sections.visualState: sliding dark record panels close in; verdict cards become procedure tags
sections.transitionOut: lamp switches from diagnosis light to emergency exposure at chorus

sections.label: sabi 1
sections.emotion: defiant rescue, bright exposure, controlled anger
sections.rhythm: 37 beats; melody-density drops sharply, so the screen should broaden instead of crowding
sections.visualState: table lifts toward viewer; white-blue exposure wipes from an edge rather than center
sections.transitionOut: exposure drains into thin suture paths

sections.label: post-sabi / interlude afterimage
sections.rhythm: 66 beats; moderate note density returns but less crowded than the opening
sections.visualState: empty table outline, delayed monitor blocks, quieter public panels
sections.transitionOut: mechanical count-in returns the room to procedure mode

sections.label: A/B-melo 2 build
sections.role: second escalation, more procedural and public
sections.emotion: restless focus, pressure restarting with more procedural force
sections.rhythm: 69 beats; medium-high density with many N zones, useful for stark panel interruptions
sections.visualState: overhead monitor frame lowers; triage marks and operating marks align
sections.transitionOut: monitor grid locks into a square frame before the second chorus

sections.label: sabi 2 / frozen chorus
sections.role: repeat chorus candidate with a striking Songle melody gap
sections.emotion: frozen exposure, suspended breath, hard judgment
sections.rhythm: 37 beats; melody note count is zero in Songle, so use beat/chord/manual cues
sections.visualState: almost frozen white table, hard shadow cuts, public grid dimmed
sections.transitionOut: shadow cuts break into diagonal seams

sections.label: bridge / operation drift A
sections.role: reconstruction begins; the procedure becomes uncertain
sections.rhythm: 47 beats; medium density, suited for slower tracing over the same tempo
sections.visualState: suture paths trace around negative space; fewer small panels
sections.transitionOut: sutures pull into larger record seams

sections.label: bridge / lift into final
sections.emotion: resolve forming, breath gathering, tunnel vision
sections.rhythm: 44 beats; density rises slightly and D/F# dominates
sections.visualState: frame pulls open; monitor grid starts to read as an exit route, not only a judgment surface
sections.transitionOut: forward motion snaps in at final chorus

sections.label: last sabi
sections.rhythm: 37 beats; high note density returns inside the chorus window
sections.visualState: pulse route pushes forward through the monitor grid; bold pulse blocks carry the frame
sections.transitionOut: forward movement stops abruptly and monitors begin to dim

sections.label: outro / residual pulse
sections.role: decay, last life-sign, exit from the operating record
sections.rhythm: 30 beats; low note density and closing N/Bm zones
sections.visualState: monitors dim; one off-center pulse exits bottom right
